summary.text: Chris Pielli, listed by Ballotpedia as Christopher Pielli, is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 156, having taken office on December 1, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Army veteran and attorney, he lists affordability as his most pressing issue.

paragraphs.text: Pielli graduated from East Senior High School in 1984, served in the U.S. Army from 1989 to 1995, and earned a bachelor's degree from Temple University in 1988 and a J.D. from Temple in 2000.
His career experience includes working as a government administrator.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Pielli said he is an attorney in good standing in New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania and has also been a soldier, teacher, correctional officer and counselor, and veterans' advocate.

In the 2023-2024 session, Pielli was assigned to the Commerce Committee, where he was subcommittee chair on Automation and Technology, and to the Committee on Committees and the Environmental Resources & Energy, Game & Fisheries, and Judiciary committees.
In the survey, he said affordability is the most pressing issue and named raising the minimum wage, passing paid family leave and expanding working-family tax credits among his priorities.
